events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. Which legendary performance defined the festival for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us 49 years ago today. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, six days after a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: 56 years since the world lost a guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix's sound continues to echo through rock history.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years of 'Abbey Road'! That legendary zebra crossing shot and those unforgettable tracks. What's your album highlight?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Rock icon Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today! Still sounding incredible. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis anthem he fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' became a UK single. Its message of peace is as powerful as ever.

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: The revolutionary first-generation Apple iPod was introduced on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years since it dropped and changed everything. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His songs continue to inspire and resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece. What's your go-to track from the double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
